name: project-map-kit
description: Configuration-driven project architecture, flows and evidence in a static dashboard

scripts.build:demo: npm run build:demo:en && npm run build:demo:zh
scripts.validate:demo: node bin/project-map.mjs validate --root examples && node bin/project-map.mjs validate --root examples --config project-map.zh-CN.json
scripts.build:demo:zh: node bin/project-map.mjs build --root examples --config project-map.zh-CN.json --out dist/project-map/zh-CN
